releases.body:
# Test build for no audio on some PCs (#1165)

This build is for players who have no sound at all on 3.0.0, with `No default audio device available` in `user/last_run.log`. It is not a final release.

## What changes

- When Windows reports no default audio device and SDL gives no driver name, the game now tries DirectSound before it goes silent. Before, that fallback only ran when the driver was named WASAPI.
- Everything else is 3.0.0.

## How to test

1. Copy your save folder first.
2. Extract `spartanport-windows.zip` into a **new folder**, so your current install stays as it is.
3. Start the game and check whether the intro and the gameplay have sound.
4. Reply on #1165 with **sound** or **still silent**, plus your `user/last_run.log`.

## Validation

- The new audio test failed before the fix and passes after it, together with the existing WASAPI fallback, forced driver and total failure tests, and the downmix test (MSYS2 CLANG64, warnings as errors).
- Built and opened on a clean Windows runner by the release workflow.
- Not checked in game: we could not reproduce a PC with no default audio device.

# Test build 2 for infinite loading screens (#1131)

This build is for players stuck on a loading screen that never ends. It is not a final release: it tells us whether fixes that are not in 2.7.0 yet remove the hang, and if not, where the load stops.

## What changes

- **Memory fixes from #1005**, already on `main` but in no release yet. Among them, copy threads now read guest memory through a second view, so they no longer wait on a GPU thread that waits on them.
- **Texture cache, GPU and shader cache fixes from #1124.** On graphics cards with less than 8 GB, texture pressure now starts at 60% of the budget instead of about 40%, the collector no longer gets stuck behind images it must keep, and an old "GPU idle" signal can no longer release newer work.

### Fixed

- Frame captures (`RPS5E_CAPTURE_FRAMES`) of GTA V replay again instead of hanging the GPU. While a capture recorded, GPU results copied straight into guest memory were later taken for CPU writes and recorded; the replay wrote them over its own GPU results, which differ where GPU work orders its atomics differently, and the mixed ray-tracing tree sent a shader into an endless loop. ### Added

- Display resolution setting (720p, 1080p or 2160p) in the launcher, the "Run with..." dialog, `--display-resolution` and `RPS5E_DISPLAY_RESOLUTION`: games that ask the console for the TV's resolution are told the chosen one, as a PS5 on that TV would answer; the default stays 2160p.

The library now tracks its initialized and open-handle state (`NOT_INITIALIZED`, `ALREADY_INITIALIZED`, `BAD_HANDLE` after close), remembers the install speed that was set, and answers a chunk-id count query made without a list buffer.

### Performance

- GTA V in the city: the longest stalls are much shorter (about 2.5 s instead of 10 s) and driving stutters far less. The frame rate in the city is still low (about 7 fps now that the ray-traced reflections are drawn) and far from playable.
- Wave64 compute shaders on 32-wide GPUs (NVIDIA): lane stacks and register spills stay in registers, ballots share one exchange, and programs from 16 VGPRs run split; the ray traversal of GTA V takes about a third of its former GPU time.

releases.body:
# Zaxnes 0.2.0

Independent project, not affiliated with Geod Studio or Nintendo. NES is a trademark of Nintendo.

## New

- **Import from 3dSen.** If you own 3dSen, `File > Import from 3dSen…` (or `--import-3dsen <folder>`) copies the game profiles from your installation into your Zaxnes profiles folder. Nothing is downloaded and no profile ships with Zaxnes.
- **`profiles` folder next to `Zaxnes.exe`.** Profiles placed there are always loaded, in portable mode or not. A file with the same name in your user profiles folder takes priority.
- **English or French interface.** English by default; switch in `Options > Interface`. The change applies immediately.

## Improved

- Sharper shadows of thin details: status-bar text and other fine strokes are much more readable (4096 shadow map).
- Unlit faces are darker, closer to the expected look.
- Anti-aliasing and the resolution scale now really change the rendering.
- Starting in fullscreen no longer shows a black screen.
- Ctrl+C in the console no longer closes the emulator; the console is used only by `--help`, `--list-profiles` and `--import-3dsen`.

## Removed

- The decorative CRT TV around the picture, and its third-party model.
